integrity: Complete argument and exact-arithmetic checker included. Empirical finite checks are not substituted for infinite proofs. No authorship or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The one-lag covariance reduction is elementary and not claimed as original. The new claim concerns natural densities over all positive shifts and the fixed-prime high-column Lambert-series limit. The priority search is not exhaustive: the earlier 2001 binomial digital-function paper was not inspected in full. No external independent proof review has been carried out.
title: Arithmetic density of positive lag covariance in prime-power Pascal columns
